question: If 85% of (x - y) = 25% of (x + y), Then y is what percentage of x?
solution:
**Given:**

85% of (x - y) = 25% of (x + y)

**Concept:**

Equating and rearranging the equation

**Solution:**

⇒ 0.85x - 0.85y = 0.25x + 0.25y

⇒ 0.85x - 0.25x = 0.85y + 0.25y

⇒ 0.6x = 1.1y

⇒ y = 0.6x / 1.1

⇒ y = 0.545x = 54{6 over 11}

**Therefore, y is **​​**54{6 over 11}% of x.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**85% of (x - y) = 25% of (x + y)

⇒ 85(x - y) = 25(x + y)

⇒ x(85 - 25) = y(85 + 25)

⇒ 60 x = 110 y

In percentage 

⇒ y = x(60/110)× 100

⇒ y = 54{6 over 11}x

∴ y is ​​54{6 over 11}% of x.
